name: varavista/autocad-mcp

items.name: Geometry and measurement
items.basis: Report shows line/circle/rectangle/polyline/arc/ellipse/mtext/hatch created in live AutoCAD via COM with handles, and entity.get returning area/radius/length read back from AutoCAD. ezdxf has length/area/bounding-box/polyline_info code.
items.scope_and_limits: The only behavioral evidence is MCP_VALIDATION_REPORT.md: a narrative checklist written by an AI agent against AutoCAD 2026 via the COM backend on 2026-04-03, with returned handles but no raw tool outputs. Relative to the code it exercised, the pinned commit only added setup_lisp to the COM backend, so the other COM paths are traced as unchanged. COM geometry.* (distance/length/area/bounding_box) returns 'Not supported'; ezdxf measurement has no output evidence. Hatch islands and topology are not addressed.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: no error/boundary behavioral evidence; the dedicated measurement tool is unsupported on the evidenced backend and untested elsewhere; no islands/topology.

items.name: Editing
items.basis: Report shows copy/move/rotate/scale/mirror/offset/array/erase working via COM in live AutoCAD (array 2x2 -> 3 new handles).
items.scope_and_limits: The only behavioral evidence is MCP_VALIDATION_REPORT.md: a narrative checklist written by an AI agent against AutoCAD 2026 via the COM backend on 2026-04-03, with returned handles but no raw tool outputs. Relative to the code it exercised, the pinned commit only added setup_lisp to the COM backend, so the other COM paths are traced as unchanged. trim/extend/join/fillet/chamfer/break/explode are unsupported on COM. On ezdxf, fillet/chamfer/offset return 'not supported' (contradicting the report's coverage table) and trim is LINE-only and picks the kept side by a t>=0.5 heuristic rather than a pick point. No requirement-driven edits or identity tracking.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: ordinary transforms only; corner/trim operations absent or heuristic, no error/boundary evidence, no requirement-driven change or identity checks.

items.name: Annotation and styles
items.basis: Text and a linear dimension were created via COM in live AutoCAD (report). ezdxf has aligned/angular/radius dimension and leader code calling ezdxf render().
items.scope_and_limits: The only behavioral evidence is MCP_VALIDATION_REPORT.md: a narrative checklist written by an AI agent against AutoCAD 2026 via the COM backend on 2026-04-03, with returned handles but no raw tool outputs. Relative to the code it exercised, the pinned commit only added setup_lisp to the COM backend, so the other COM paths are traced as unchanged. No numeric tolerances/fits, no dimension or text style creation/modification, and no displayed-text readback after editing anywhere in the code. aligned/angular/radius/leader are unsupported on COM; ezdxf annotation has no output evidence.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: key item capabilities (tolerances/fits, styles, post-edit display verification) are not implemented.

items.name: Organization and exchange
items.basis: Layer list/create/set_current/freeze/thaw/lock/unlock worked via COM (report). Code exists for blocks/attributes, xrefs, layouts, save/save_as_dxf, plot_pdf, wblock.
items.scope_and_limits: The only behavioral evidence is MCP_VALIDATION_REPORT.md: a narrative checklist written by an AI agent against AutoCAD 2026 via the COM backend on 2026-04-03, with returned handles but no raw tool outputs. Relative to the code it exercised, the pinned commit only added setup_lisp to the COM backend, so the other COM paths are traced as unchanged. block insert/define/attributes, save, save_as_dxf, plot_pdf and wblock were all skipped; layouts/xrefs are unsupported on COM. Source shows COM save_as_dxf calls SaveAs(path, 1) = acR12_dxf (lossy R12 downgrade). ezdxf layout_page_setup, viewport_set_scale, viewport_lock and layout_batch_plot return ok=true without changing anything; layout_viewport_create ignores scale.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: exchange/save, blocks with attributes and paper space have no output evidence; demonstrated ok=true no-op layout/viewport/plot operations (false success, would cap at 2).

items.name: Domain workflows
items.basis: Code for P&ID symbols/lines, electrical NEC tables/circuit trace/panel schedule, equipment find/inspect, BOM and NLP commands. Report shows equipment_find/find_text (text search) and one NLP line command working on COM.
items.scope_and_limits: The only behavioral evidence is MCP_VALIDATION_REPORT.md: a narrative checklist written by an AI agent against AutoCAD 2026 via the COM backend on 2026-04-03, with returned handles but no raw tool outputs. Relative to the code it exercised, the pinned commit only added setup_lisp to the COM backend, so the other COM paths are traced as unchanged. P&ID, electrical and BOM are all unsupported on COM and untested on other backends. No mechanical views, architectural rooms/openings, or takeoff with uncertainty.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: domain workflows have no output evidence beyond text search; most item areas absent.

items.name: Transactions
items.basis: File IPC serialises commands with an asyncio lock; COM undo/redo exist and the report marks undo/redo working.
items.scope_and_limits: No batch atomicity, preview, conflict detection or checkpoints. COM batch_draw_* return ok=true with per-item errors and no rollback; undo/redo send '_undo 1' via SendCommand and report success without checking the result. ezdxf has no undo (can_undo=false).

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: transaction capabilities are absent; partial batch failures are returned as ok=true.

items.name: Intent and geometry
items.basis: No saved specifications, requirement binding, or dimension-vs-geometry verification exists. validate.* tools check layer names, duplicates and zero-length entities only.
items.scope_and_limits: Source shows reported success without effect: ezdxf drawing_purge returns purged=true doing nothing; ezdxf layout/viewport/plot no-ops return ok=true; COM setup_lisp returns ok=true and lisp_loaded=true without confirming the load.

deduction.reason: Withhold 5: no verified implementation of intent/geometry checking; several demonstrated false-success paths.

items.name: Delivery
items.basis: Save/save_as/plot_pdf/wblock write files, but nothing gates, hashes, reads back or compares the delivered file.
items.scope_and_limits: Save paths are untested (skipped in the report). COM save_as_dxf writes R12 DXF, a lossy format, without telling the caller. ezdxf saveas overwrites any path silently.

deduction.reason: Withhold 5: no delivery gate, version/hash, readback or parity implementation.

items.name: Foreign and abnormal inputs
items.basis: drawing_open catches read errors and returns ok=false; ezdxf audit wraps doc.audit(); IPC polling tolerates partially written JSON; unsupported operations return explicit 'Not supported on this backend'.
items.scope_and_limits: No corruption, unknown-unit, external-edit or incomplete-data cases have output evidence. electrical_nec_lookup returns ok=true for an unknown table (error only inside the payload).

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: entry points only; no behavioral evidence for abnormal inputs.

items.name: Backend contract
items.basis: Auto-detection (File IPC -> COM -> ezdxf), runtime switch_backend, status with capability flags, and explicit 'Not supported on this backend' refusals; the report shows status/list_supported/switch_backend and honest refusals on COM.
items.scope_and_limits: The only behavioral evidence is MCP_VALIDATION_REPORT.md: a narrative checklist written by an AI agent against AutoCAD 2026 via the COM backend on 2026-04-03, with returned handles but no raw tool outputs. Relative to the code it exercised, the pinned commit only added setup_lisp to the COM backend, so the other COM paths are traced as unchanged. Postconditions are inconsistent across backends (ezdxf no-ops return ok=true). The committed coverage table claims ezdxf supports fillet/chamfer/offset and lacks layouts, contradicting the source. auto mode silently falls back to an in-memory ezdxf document.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: no error/boundary evidence for missing dependencies; capability boundaries are documented inaccurately and postconditions differ between backends.

items.name: Native interoperability
items.basis: Real AutoCAD 2026 COM session: entity creation, transforms, layers, text, linear dimension, hatch, queries, screenshot, purge, undo/redo (report).
items.scope_and_limits: The only behavioral evidence is MCP_VALIDATION_REPORT.md: a narrative checklist written by an AI agent against AutoCAD 2026 via the COM backend on 2026-04-03, with returned handles but no raw tool outputs. Relative to the code it exercised, the pinned commit only added setup_lisp to the COM backend, so the other COM paths are traced as unchanged. save/open/save_as_dxf/plot_pdf were skipped, AUDIT is unsupported on COM, File IPC (AutoCAD LT) has no recorded run, and ZWCAD/GstarCAD/BricsCAD are claimed but untested.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: no native save/reopen/AUDIT evidence; only one backend and one CAD exercised; narrative evidence.

items.name: Platforms
items.basis: Only Windows evidence: the AutoCAD COM report and a committed pytest_output.txt from a Windows .venv.
items.scope_and_limits: No CI, no Linux run, no multiple-Python runs; the committed pytest run errored at the first test. The headless ezdxf path, which carries the cross-platform claim, has no successful run.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: single-platform narrative evidence; no headless or cross-platform run.

items.name: Defaults and boundaries
items.basis: stdio-only transport; the LISP dispatcher maps command names through a whitelist rather than eval.
items.scope_and_limits: system.execute_lisp is enabled by default and writes arbitrary code to a file that the dispatcher loads with SECURELOAD set to 0, so the whitelist is bypassed. setup_lisp lets a tool call run a PowerShell script with -ExecutionPolicy Bypass that writes AutoCAD Startup Suite registry entries. Open/save/xref/wblock accept any path with no scope. No read-only mode.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: dangerous execution and persistent configuration changes are on by default; no path or operation scope (permission defect, would cap at 2).

items.name: Long tasks
items.basis: File IPC has a single in-flight asyncio lock, a configurable timeout (1-300 s), stale-file cleanup, a retry after window re-detection, and structlog logging; client init is locked.
items.scope_and_limits: No output evidence. A timed-out command is not cancelled in AutoCAD; on the retry after a window change a non-idempotent command can run twice. time.sleep blocks the event loop inside dispatch. COM calls have no lock or timeout.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: mechanisms exist but are unevidenced; no cancellation or crash recovery.

declared_contract: A unified Python MCP server (v5.1.0, stdio) exposing 22 tool groups (drawing, entity, layer, block, annotation, P&ID, view, query, search, geometry, select/bulk, validate, export, xref, layout, electrical NEC, connection, batch, NLP, Excel export) over three backends: File IPC (JSON files plus an AutoLISP dispatcher triggered in AutoCAD LT via PostMessage), Windows COM (AutoCAD 2018+, ZWCAD, GstarCAD, BricsCAD) and headless ezdxf. Backend auto-detection with runtime switching; operations a backend does not override return 'Not supported on this backend'.
evidence_used: MCP_VALIDATION_REPORT.md (agent-written COM checklist against AutoCAD 2026, dated 2026-04-03; COM code traced unchanged except the added setup_lisp)
pytest_output.txt (committed Windows run; errored at the first test and stopped)
gh run list -R varavista/autocad-mcp: no runs; no .github directory

serious_defects.description: ezdxf layout_page_setup, layout_viewport_set_scale, layout_viewport_lock and layout_batch_plot return ok=true without changing the drawing or producing output.
ezdxf drawing_purge returns ok=true, purged=true and does nothing; COM setup_lisp reports lisp_loaded=true and ok=true without confirming the load or the registry step.
electrical_voltage_drop substitutes 1.0 ohm/1000ft for an unknown wire gauge and returns ok=true with an 'acceptable' verdict.

execute_lisp is on by default and loads arbitrary agent-supplied AutoLISP with SECURELOAD=0, bypassing the dispatcher whitelist; setup_lisp writes AutoCAD startup registry entries via PowerShell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass from a tool call.
COM batch_draw_* returns ok=true when some or all items fail (errors only in the payload), with no rollback.

limitations: No code was executed; defects come from source reading only and were not reproduced.
The native evidence is an agent-written narrative without raw outputs; its coverage table contains claims the source contradicts, so only rows marked as actually run were used.
File IPC / AutoCAD LT, ZWCAD, GstarCAD and BricsCAD paths have no recorded run and were scored from source only.
The COM save_as_dxf R12 reading (SaveAs(path, 1) = acR12_dxf) comes from the AutoCAD AcSaveAsType enumeration, not observed output.
lisps/jxp_shelf_detail.lsp, batch_tag.py and check_ipc.py are auxiliary scripts outside the MCP tool contract and were not scored.
